text:
sophia: quick riff  proposing we reduce left-rail clutter by putting Models, Deployments, and Runtimes under a single parent called 'Inference'. sketch: https://img.redwood/mock/inference-consolidated.png. main problems to solve: deep-link fidelity, breadcrumb clarity, and permalink stability. thoughts?

rahul: visual declutter = yes. first question: what happens to old bookmarks? we need deterministic redirects and a TTL for the redirect table. also preserve query params for experiments.

olivia: accessibility first: when a deep link lands on a nested page, expand the parent programmatically, set aria-expanded=true, then shift focus to the main H1 (or primary CTA). breadcrumb must be semantically nav > ol > li with aria-current on the active item. if the visual breadcrumb truncates on small screens, provide an accessible full-path announcement.

kevin: routing constraints: avoid hash-only hacks. prefer canonical routes like /inference/models/:id and implement server-side 301/302 redirects from /models/:id -> /inference/models/:id. client should resolve redirects before rendering breadcrumbs to avoid flashes. use history.replaceState for UI-only toggles so back button behavior is preserved.

sam: implementation idea: on route resolve, run redirect resolution first, then synchronously expand nav parents, mount page, call focus() on H1. if expansion requires async data, render a small skeleton so SRs don't get out-of-order announcements. we'll also emit telemetry events for redirects.

maria: small UX ask: show a transient dismissible banner when a redirect occurs: "Redirected from /models/123 to /inference/models/123". helps users report stale links. keep redirects live for at least 90 days.

olivia: QA checklist suggestion: 1) deep link with collapsed rail lands in content and focuses H1, 2) screenreader reads full breadcrumb even if visually truncated, 3) keyboard nav works in icon-only mode with visible focus rings, 4) query params preserved across redirect, 5) reduced-motion respected for expansion animations, 6) localized breadcrumb copy tested for overflow.

rahul: mobile nuance: if a user has a persisted collapsed preference, a deep link should temporarily override (session-only) so they land in content but their saved setting remains unchanged. also preserve query strings for A/B params.

kevin: small perf/UX: hold breadcrumb render until redirect resolution to avoid flicker. prototype currently had a fragment toggle that caused breadcrumb mismatch; switch to route-driven expansion. sam, can you schedule this fix?

sam: on it. i'll change router to pre-resolve redirects and expand parents synchronously. will add skeleton and ensure history.replaceState for toggles. will also ensure link-preserving for query params and send telemetry when a redirect happened.

preview-bot: preview up: https://deploy.redwood/pr/2134 (inference-rail-v4). includes keyboard walkthrough and a11y notes.

sophia: thanks all  i'll update the mock to include the transient banner and tooltip copy: "Models, deployments, and runtimes for serving models". maria will run a quick hallway poll on label choice (Inference vs Serve). will reconvene after Sam's router change. :sparkles:
